product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil Vacuum Cleaner 360 Reach Pro Corded Bagless Stick and Handheld Vacuum SD12515B
features: Versatility to clean where your upright vacuum can’t, perfect for daily cleaning of pet hair and other debris
Accessory tools easily switch out to allow you to go from floors to ceilings to couches in seconds
Cyclonic Filtration- cuts through any mess with powerful suction
Lightweight and compact- easy to use, easy to store
Includes Fan Tool, Hard Floor Tool, Above Floor Tool, Extension Wand, Swipes Washable Microfiber Pad and Storage Bag
description: Vac, dust and reach- versatility to clean where your upright vacuum can't. 360 Degree Reach Pro speeds through messes from floor to ceiling with 4 multipurpose tools that easily switch this vacuum from a stick to a handheld and back again. Use the 6" wide powered tool to easily convert the 360 to a hand vacuum. It's powerful brush roll is perfect for stairs and upholstery inside as well as a handy car vacuum. Snap back on the extension wand to convert to a stick vacuum and reach up to 12 feet high and low. Use the crevice tool to tackle the toughest cleaning spots and hard to reach cracks. For ceiling fan blades, use the Vac+Dust Ceiling Fan Tool that comes complete with a Swipes Washable Microfiber Pad. For floorwork, attach the Vac+Dust Hard Floor Tool with Swipes Washable Microfiber Pad. It's the combination of a powerful vacuum and the Swipes Microfiber pad that allows you to pick up the dust and debris rather than just pushing it around on the floor. When done simply flip a switch to empty the dirt cup on the bottom and put everything back in the storage bag. The 360 Degree Reach is everything you need for in between cleaning with your upright vacuum and comes with a 3 year warranty.
